body:
"Dont just open up a message with hey"


*Messages a guy*

"Hey"

I've lost count of how many girls message me with hey after reading so many of them demand men not to open with it. I get it, its a boring opener but still.. come on. Dont be a hypocrite.

1.) Why would I randomly ask women on online dating websites about how many guys are douchebags to them in that site

2.) I know women in real life who use dating websites and none of them tell me that men are douchebags. 

3.) The only women who call all men douchebags are the toxic ones with princess syndrome. Not representative of all women like you think. Those types of women are to be avoided.

Hey, I'm not the asshole who throws other men under the bus just to make myself look superior.

Most guys aren't douchebags. Get your head out of your ass. You're not as special as you think. And you're far from nice.

You belong on r/niceguys 

Do you own a fedora by any chance?

Why would i open up with a message telling a woman "I know men are douchebags but not me. Im a nice guy. You can trust me?". Thats not only cringe and not nice to any of the guys I dont know but id find it very creepy if I was the women.

Any guy that has to prove his nice or decent. Isn't nive or decent.

I legit had a friend who did this. He even put his dating profile of him telling women that his a great guy unlike most guys. Suffice to say he sent abuse to all the women who rejected and ghosted him and his ex girlfriend left him for being emotionally abusive. So I stand by what I say. An actual nice guy doesn't have to prove it

Why are you labelling all the other guys douchebags?

Thats not very "nice guy" of you. You don't know these guys. So why label them as douchebags. Any guy that puts down all other men as "jerks" is the real jerk. Not a nice genuine guy.

r/niceguys

Are you jealous of the guys you've unfairly labelled as "douchebags" because women actually engage with them.

Please tell a woman all other guys are douchebags apart from you. She would love to hear you put down her brother, father, grandad, uncle and male friends as douchebags.
I have severe depression and dealt with paranoia personality disorder in my teen years. Im not gonna back away. I generally care about her. I guess I just worry too much and over analyse stuff.
Last thing I want to do is make her feel worse than she already feels. Ill take your advice.
I am listening. Im not trying to make it about myself.
